source_reconstruction.standing: V is C2;0<alpha<=beta;alpha I<=HessV<=beta I;eta>0 and beta*eta<=1. The deterministic claim lives in finite Euclidean phase space, represented coordinate-free with Borel canonical volume.
source_reconstruction.time_domain: For any n>=0,T>=0, strict ordered simplex Delta_n(T)={0<t1<...<tn<T}; simplex Lebesgue must agree with existing subtype comap measure, without normalization.
source_reconstruction.phase_endpoint: A(z,tau)=actual prescribed path endpoint at T after n reflections and intervening literal harmonic flows. For fixed tau it is a Borel volume-preserving bijection.
source_reconstruction.time_map: rho_T(tau)_i=T-tau_(n+1-i); this is an affine signed permutation preserving strict ordered simplex and its measure, involutive. Source calls it linear, but the affine offset changes no Jacobian factor.
source_reconstruction.full_map: Theta(z,tau)=(R A(z,tau),rho_T(tau)), where R(x,p)=(x,-p). Claim joint Borel measurability, pointwise involutivity and preservation of ell.prod(m_nT).
source_reconstruction.inverse_mechanism: Actual endpoint identity A(R A(z,tau),rho_T(tau))=R z; it derives from reversed arc gaps, flow reversal, bounce involution and bounce/reversal commutation.
source_reconstruction.measure_mechanism: Finite phase compositions preserve ell for each tau; time map preserves m; joint measurability plus Fubini/skew-product gives full product preservation. Separate fixed-fiber claims alone are not the full substitution.
source_reconstruction.zero_cases: n0: empty tuple has mass1,A=Phi_T,Theta phase R Phi_T. T0 with n>0: empty simplex; T0,n0:Theta phase R. Rank0 and zero normals included.
source_reconstruction.path_boundary: Actual A2 values are post-bounce. Source formal path-reversal notation is only valid off finite events or with left-limit completion at reversed events; endpoint T is safe because all events are strictly interior.
source_reconstruction.excluded: A4 Gibbs-survival balance,A5 weight product matching,A7 stochastic expansion,stationary averaging/invariance,restart/Markovness,L2 semigroup,costs and whole-paper/composition completion remain separate.
